notes: Single source of truth for Northwest Town Car Service pricing. Edit here (or via the admin screen, which exports this file). No rates are hard-coded anywhere else.

airportFlatRates.note: One-way flat rate between SEA and the named service area, either direction. Vans and Sprinters to/from the airport are priced by manual quote.

hourly.note: Billed hours = max(requested hours, class minimum).

passThrough.note: Parking and tolls are billed at actual cost and added after the trip. Any estimate shown to the customer is non-binding.

fees.note: Both default to 0. Set only with the owner's approval; changes are logged.

tax.label: WA sales tax
tax.note: Defaults to 0. Washington's tax treatment of passenger ground transportation varies by service and jurisdiction — confirm the correct rate with the business's accountant before enabling. When set, tax applies to the discounted service subtotal plus fees, not to gratuity or pass-through costs.

gratuity.note: Shown as its own line. Calculated on the discounted service subtotal (before tax and pass-through). Corporate accounts may set a fixed gratuity policy that overrides the customer's choice.

contract.label: Contract
contract.note: Rate is set per signed agreement and passed in as the contract rate; the table discount does not apply.

deposit.note: A deposit is collected ONLY after dispatch confirms the ride is real and the driver/vehicle is assigned. It is never collected in the quote funnel. Card entry happens on Stripe's hosted checkout — card data never touches NWTC servers.

customQuote.note: Default for weddings / events / out-of-area. Dispatch can override per quote.

corporate.note: Billed on account per the rate agreement — no deposit.

cash.note: Customer pays the driver the full fare in cash at the end of the trip. No online deposit. Dispatch approves every cash booking; if a card deposit is wanted to hold the slot, send a normal deposit link instead and note the balance is due in cash.

restrictions.note: Above maxFare, or for a first-time customer, the booking is held for dispatch approval rather than auto-confirmed.
